claims.quote: This species is endemic to the state of Kerala in southwestern India, where it has been recorded from the Bharathapuzha, Chalakudy, Muvattupuzha, Periyar, Ponnani, Meenachil, Achenkovil, Chaliyar, and Manimala river systems.
